pullRequests.title: fix(index): bind a review approval to the archives' SHA-256
pullRequests.author: nickyyOO
pullRequests.head: feature/approve-by-hash
pullRequests.body:
Before
A maintainer approved a version by its number only. The author could replace a release archive after the review, and the index then published the new, unreviewed file.
After
The approval stores the SHA-256 of each archive shown on the review issue. If an archive changes, that version waits for review again. The bot reopens the closed issue (or warns on the open one) and removes the approved label.
How

submit_bot.py review writes the hashes on the issue's last line. Only that line…

commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The game leaves +0x6C (the experience to the next version) at 0 on a
weapon's last row, which its bars draw as full; the mod now writes the
next tier's goal there each tick. The game's level check skips every
last version, so it never acts on the value.

The port's text slots live in its own region (0xE0200000), which the
mod's range check refused, so the vendor kept "Mega". Log the first
text the mod gives, and list the three optional hooks in the manifest.
